Container.Name: LivePoster
Container.Overview: LivePoster is a media poster display server that monitors your home theater systems (Kaleidescape, Plex, Jellyfin) and displays movie/TV posters. When media is playing, it shows the current content with progress bar. When idle, it cycles through your library as a slideshow.
Container.Description:
LivePoster monitors your media systems and displays beautiful movie posters on any screen.
Features: - Real-time monitoring with progress tracking - Automatic slideshow when idle - TMDb and Rotten Tomatoes integration - Web-based management interface - Settings UI for easy configuration

Config.Name: Kaleidescape Player IP
Config.Description: IP address of your Kaleidescape PLAYER - this is the device that answers play-status queries (e.g., 192.168.1.50)

Config.Name: Kaleidescape Movie Server IP
Config.Description: IP address of the Kaleidescape MOVIE SERVER that serves the /movies library page (e.g., a Terra at 192.168.1.51). Leave blank if the player and server are the same device.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex authentication token (see Settings in app)

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: Jellyfin API key (see Settings in app)

Config.Name: TMDb API Key
Config.Description: TheMovieDB API key for movie metadata (get at themoviedb.org)

Config.Name: OMDb API Key
Config.Description: OMDb API key for Rotten Tomatoes scores (get at omdbapi.com)

Config.Name: Poll Interval
Config.Description: How often to check for playback changes (milliseconds)

Config.Name: Slideshow Interval
Config.Description: How often to change slides when idle (milliseconds)
